_notes: D6 - Recalculate after setup change (catalog D6, plan test-plans/journey-d/d06-recalculate-after-setup-change.md, runner row D6). dayOffset -11 is Journey D's own fixture day (Journey B owns 0...-9, Journey C took -10), so the three suites never collide on the same day's cards.

The minimum transferable day (measured live 2026-09-29): crew time-in + crew piece-out (respecting maximumNumberOfPieces=5) + crew time-out, all on the same crew and job. numOfPieces=4 splits to 2 pieces per employee across the two D6 pickers.

rate.before/after is the catalog's own example, 'a piece rate from one dollar to two'. expected.amountBefore/After are pieces-per-card x rate, pinned so a stale rate or a minimum-wage make-up would fail loudly at the arrange step rather than being swallowed by the later delta.
label: d06-recalculate-transferred-job-cards

annotations.description: Recalculate leaves the job card's amount at 0 while pieceAmount tracks the rate correctly (measured live 2026-09-29). The spec asserts pieceAmount, never amount; amount is recorded as an annotation only. File against board 357 (qa-beta-test + journey-d) if not already tracked.

Skip reasons (exported, dateLocked, noTimeRange, rateLookupFailed, notFound, updateFailed, other) and the bodyVisible/bodyExportScope confirm variants need data or scope this spec is forbidden to create/use — separate tickets.
